shared_elements: frontal human head with schematic face
straight vertical nose joined to brow
flat lipped mouth rendered as a horizontal band
hair or headdress mass framing the head
justification: Both depict a frontal, blocky anthropomorphic head with the same conventional facial scheme: a continuous horizontal brow from which a straight vertical nose descends in a T, narrow linear eyes set beneath the brow either side of the nose, and a straight banded mouth, all on a squared columnar body/head mass with a framing headdress or hair block. The chief difference in content is that A additionally carries an elaborate programme of incised body ornament (circular disc, curvilinear motifs, belt-like bands, pendant elements) covering the torso, whereas B shows only the bare head with no accompanying motifs, so the relational and compositional evidence beyond the face is limited.
